insert.behavior: First empty slot; duplicate codes do not merge.

remove.behavior: Shift following slots left and clear the last slot. Return value not treated as a success flag. Caller must reject negative index.

tail.behavior: Return actor inventory slot 7, not an item count.

equip.success: Return old item code after replacing slot. Check job, type and old item flags2 bit 1.

unequip.success: Return old code and clear slot. Caller validates slot index.

job_bit.behavior: Jobs 80..100 map to bits 0..20; other jobs return -1. Equip separately exempts job 1000.

take_off_loader.behavior: Nonzero take_off sets flags2 bit 1, which blocks replacement/unequip.

apply_equipment.behavior: Apply type-specific base contribution and common numeric/passive fields.

live_policy.inventory: Eight integer code slots; ordered duplicate entries; first-hole insertion; left-compacting removal.
live_policy.replace: Confirm once, remove selected inventory entry, exchange equipment, append old equipment, refresh, then commit atomically.
live_policy.unequip: Refuse when backpack has no room; weapons must be replaced until an unarmed range is established.
live_policy.action: Equipment and discard preserve the action; ordinary original window closure now has static evidence. Confirmation and reversible pending movement remain remake interaction policies.
live_policy.same_code: No-op rejection; native setter itself can return the same old code.
live_policy.scope: Leonard/SwordMan refresh; supported numeric equipment only. Unsupported nonzero passive effects reject equip.

instruction_anchors.reviewed_meaning: Inventory starts at actor+0x138.
Insert branches on empty code 0, not matching item code.
Advance one DWORD until exactly eight slots have been checked.
Full insert returns 0 without a slot write.
Write new code to first empty slot and return 1.
Removal copies 7-index following slots; oversized index exits.
Copy following DWORDs one slot left with rep movsd.
Clear last slot at actor+0x154, then return.
Tail helper returns the last item code.
Job 1000 bypasses the ordinary job mask gate.
Check item+0xa8 against the job bit; zero intersection rejects.
Unsigned slot index above 5 rejects.
CL=2 is retained for the old-equipment blocking-bit test.
Six slot/type dispatch destinations; accessories share the type-6 case.
Keep old equipped code in EDI.
Old item+0xa4 bit 1 must be clear before writing replacement.
Write new equipped code then return old code from EDI.
Unequip uses the same bit; blocked returns 0.
Allowed unequip clears selected slot and returns retained old code.
Original NUL-terminated field name: take_off.
Loader looks up take_off through the numeric field helper.
Nonzero take_off adds flag value 2.
Store assembled flags at item+0xa4.
UI holds selected code at 0x4c1ce4, then removes its inventory slot.
UI inserts its previously held code through the same first-empty helper.
UI reads held code; zero selects unequip, nonzero replacement.
UI calls replacement setter and tests return against -1.
Successful replacement makes old equipment the held code.
Successful replacement calls unified stat refresh.
Unequip result becomes the held code.
Successful unequip calls unified stat refresh.
